name: Shaahkar
description: The shaahkar is a fabled guardian of tombs, protecting vast hordes of treasure and the bodies of ancient rulers. They are notable for having the head of a jackal and body of a large humanoid.

actions.name: Guardian's Glaive
actions.description: The shaahkar swings it's glaive at a creature, dealing physical damage. In the event of a true hit, the shaahkar gains a 1d4 bonus to all defense checks until the start of their next turn.

actions.name: Curse of Time
actions.description: The shaahkar touches a creature, and bestows the touch of time. While focusing on this ability, at the start of each of the target's turns, they take 2d4 true damage and their movement speed is reduced by 1. If they reach 0 health while their movement speed is 0, their body disintegrates into sand.

actions.name: Pommel Strike
actions.description: The shaahkar strikes a creature with the blunt end of their glaive, dealing physical damage. A creature must make a concentration check greater than or equal to the damage received after mitigation or they lose their focus and become dazed until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Spinning Slash
actions.description: The shaahkar spins their glaive in a circle, slashing all creatures within a 2 unit radius. This attack does not deal splash damage.

actions.name: Attack of Opportunity
actions.description: In response to a creature leaving the shaahkar's area of control, it makes an attack with it's Guardian's Glaive action.

actions.name: Sand Shift
actions.description: The shaahktar turns into a whirling mass of sand, reforming within 4 units.

traits.name: Immovable Guardian
traits.description: The shaahkar is incredibly sturdy and sure-footed and is immune to effects that would displace it.
